data_description.name: Name of the pool device.
data_description.chlorinator: Switch of the salt water chlorinator (optional).

sensors.title: Sensors
sensors.description: Primary sensors in the flow cell and optional additional inputs.

data_description.ph_sensor: Primary pH sensor in the flow cell.
data_description.backup_ph_sensor: Used for monitoring while the pump is off (optional).
data_description.backup_orp_sensor: Used for monitoring while the pump is off (optional).
data_description.backup_temperature_sensor: Used while the pump is off (optional).
data_description.salt_sensor: Salt concentration in ppm, used for warnings only (optional).
data_description.weather: Weather entity providing the outdoor temperature (optional).
data_description.outdoor_temperature_sensor: Takes precedence over the weather entity (optional).
data_description.flow_sensor: Binary sensor that is on while water flows (optional).
data_description.pump_power_sensor: Power of the filter pump, used as flow indicator (optional).
data_description.solar_pump: Pump or valve of the solar absorber for pool heating (optional).
data_description.solar_collector_sensor: Enables the differential control of the solar heating (optional).
data_description.solar_demand_sensor: Switching output of an existing solar heating controller (optional).
data_description.pv_surplus_sensor: Photovoltaic surplus as binary sensor or power sensor in W (optional).

error.salt_invalid: The maximum must be higher than the minimum.
error.swim_ph_invalid: The maximum must be higher than the minimum.
error.solar_delta_invalid: The switch-off difference must be lower than the switch-on difference.
error.solar_source_conflict: Use either a collector temperature or a demand signal, not both.

data_description.weather: Weather entity providing the outdoor temperature (optional).
data_description.outdoor_temperature_sensor: Takes precedence over the weather entity (optional).
data_description.flow_sensor: Binary sensor that is on while water flows (optional).
data_description.pump_power_sensor: Power of the filter pump, used as flow indicator (optional).
data_description.solar_pump: Pump or valve of the solar absorber for pool heating (optional).
data_description.solar_collector_sensor: Enables the differential control of the solar heating (optional).

data_description.filtration_window_start: Earliest time the pump runs on schedule.
data_description.filtration_window_end: Latest time the pump runs on schedule.
data_description.filtration_blocks: Number of runs the daily filtration time is split into.
data_description.runtime_divisor: Daily filtration hours = water temperature / divisor.
data_description.runtime_min_hours: Lower limit of the daily filtration time.
data_description.demand_extension: Keep the pump running while chlorination or pH correction is needed.
data_description.pump_min_power: Below this power the pump is considered not pumping.

data_description.stabilization_minutes: Time after pump start before readings are used.
data_description.sensor_max_age_minutes: Readings older than this are invalid.
data_description.stuck_detection_minutes: A value unchanged for this time while pumping is invalid (0 disables).
data_description.backup_max_age_minutes: Backup readings older than this are ignored.

data_description.orp_target_mode: pH compensated uses the free chlorine target, fixed uses a constant value.
data_description.orp_fixed_target: Used in fixed mode and as fallback without pH value.
data_description.orp_hysteresis: Switch on below set point minus, off above set point plus this value.
data_description.chlorinator_no_effect_hours: Warn if ORP has not risen after this run time.
data_description.orp_holdoff_after_dosing_minutes: No chlorinator switching for this time after a pH pulse.

data_description.ph_dosing_mode: Fixed pulse or proportional to the deviation.
data_description.ph_deadband: Dose only above set point plus this value.
data_description.ph_pulse_seconds: Fixed pulse length and maximum in proportional mode.
data_description.ph_pump_auto_off_seconds: Auto-off time configured in the relay (0 if none).
data_description.ph_pump_rate: Delivery rate of the dosing pump.
data_description.ph_product_dose: Manufacturer dosage in mL per 10 m³ per 0.1 pH.
data_description.ph_max_hourly_ml: Protects against overdosing caused by sensor errors.
data_description.ph_no_effect_expected_drop: Lock dosing if the expected pH drop is reached without measurable effect.

data_description.frost_temperature: Frost protection starts below this outdoor temperature.
data_description.frost_on_minutes: Run time per hour in interval mode.
data_description.swim_data_max_age_hours: Older measurements are not used for the assessment.

data.solar_requires_filter_pump: Solar absorber in the filter circuit

data_description.solar_delta_on: Absorber minus water temperature to start the solar heating.
data_description.solar_max_water_temperature: No solar heating above this temperature.
data_description.solar_requires_filter_pump: On: the filter pump supplies the absorber and runs during solar heating. Off: the absorber has its own circuit and pump.
data_description.pv_min_surplus: Only used with a power sensor.
data_description.pv_start_delay_minutes: Surplus must be available this long before the pump starts (passing clouds).
data_description.pv_min_run_minutes: Minimum run time of a pump run started by surplus. Should exceed the stabilization time so that the run produces valid readings.

data_description.maintenance_ph_calibration_days: Interval in days, 0 disables the reminder.
data_description.maintenance_orp_calibration_days: Interval in days, 0 disables the reminder.
data_description.maintenance_backwash_days: Interval in days, 0 disables the reminder.
data_description.maintenance_cell_cleaning_days: Interval in days, 0 disables the reminder.

boost_not_possible.message: Extra circulation is not available in winter or off mode.

no_ph_pump.message: No pH dosing pump is configured.

pulse_not_possible.message: A dosing pulse is not possible: {reason}.

no_ph_value.message: No pH value available. Provide current_ph.

missing_entity.title: Entity of {name} not found
missing_entity.description: The configured entity {entity_id} does not exist. Fix the assignment in the integration options.

stabilizer_orp.title: Stabilizer affects the ORP set point of {name}
stabilizer_orp.description: The ORP chart assumes water without stabilizer. With {cya} ppm cyanuric acid the free chlorine is lower than the ORP suggests. Check the free chlorine with a test kit and use a fixed ORP set point or a higher chlorine target.

start_boost.name: Start extra circulation
start_boost.description: Runs the filter pump for an additional period.

ph_tank_refilled.name: pH minus tank refilled
ph_tank_refilled.description: Records a refill. The refilled amount calibrates the pump rate.

refilled_ml.name: Refilled amount
refilled_ml.description: Amount poured in; equals consumption if refilled to the same level.

reset_ph_lock.name: Release pH dosing lock
reset_ph_lock.description: Releases the lock set by the effect check.

calculate_ph_correction.name: Calculate pH correction
calculate_ph_correction.description: Returns the amount of pH minus product for a pH correction.

target_ph.name: Target pH
target_ph.description: Defaults to the pH set point.

record_water_test.name: Record water test
record_water_test.description: Stores the results of a manual water test.

calculate_salt_correction.name: Calculate salt correction
calculate_salt_correction.description: Returns the amount of salt to add or water to exchange.
